Lower Text: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When another of your Digimon with [Diaboromon] in its name is played, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
Upper Text: [When Digivolving] ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, 1 of their Digimon with a play cost of 8 or less can't attack players until the end of their turn.
